import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-55a40555.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Extend every 6 marker along its NW-SE diagonal across the grid.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==6:
                k=-min(r,c)
                while r+k<h and c+k<w:
                    out[r+k][c+k]=6
                    k+=1
    # Join pairs of 1 markers that lie on a diagonal.
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
        for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
            if abs(rr-r)==abs(cc-c):
                dr=1 if rr>r else -1
                dc=1 if cc>c else -1
                for k in range(abs(rr-r)+1): out[r+k*dr][c+k*dc]=1
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
